title: Gridfall Pulse
description: A small microblog for Gridfall and the rest of Verity County. Mostly road closures.

profile.bio: Short posts from Verity County. Run out of a back room on Ninth St by two people and a cat. Not affiliated with the county, the co-op, or [url=synth://verityledger.com/]the Ledger[/url]. Post what's actually happening.

feed.author: Gridfall Pulse
feed.body: Mill St closed between 4th and the bridge, water main. County says "most of the day" which means all of the day. Use 9th.

replies.author: Tunde O.
replies.body: 9th is backed to the school already. Go Quarry Rd and come in behind the feed store.

replies.author: Marguerite H.
replies.body: Third main on Mill in fourteen months. All the same block.

replies.author: Gridfall Pulse
replies.body: Reopened 3:50pm. One lane. Plates still down over the trench.

feed.author: Junie Pell
feed.body:
LOST CAT. Grey tabby, white chin, no collar (i know, i know). Answers to Biscuit, mostly doesnt. Last seen behind the laundromat on 4th tues night. He is old and he is not smart. Please look in your garage.

[img:photo:biscuit-on-chair]

replies.author: Hettie L.
replies.body: Reposted. I'll check our shed tonight, we had a stray in it last winter.

replies.author: gnash
replies.body: theres a grey cat that sits on the wall by the car wash every morning. dont know if its yours but its a grey cat

replies.author: Junie Pell
replies.body: thats the car wash cat, hes been there since 2004, but thank you

feed.author: Junie Pell
feed.body:
FOUND. he was in the crawl space UNDER OUR OWN HOUSE the entire time. two days. i put up eleven signs.

thank you everyone, genuinely.

replies.author: Marguerite H.
replies.body: Best news I've had all week and that is not saying much about the week.

replies.author: Tunde O.
replies.body: Leave one sign up. He'll do it again.

feed.author: Gridfall Pulse
feed.body:
Blue Kestrel is closing. For real this time. Delia posted a letter in the window, we went down and read it. Last service is the 29th.

[img:photo:kestrel-window-letter]

replies.author: Nedra O.
replies.body: I have read that letter three times and I am going to go and read it again.

replies.author: Curtis Flenn
replies.body: She's 71 and she's done it alone since Ken died. Nobody is allowed to be angry about this one.

replies.author: dmc
replies.body: the kestrel journal guy has been saying this since like 2004 lol. broken clock

replies.author: Gridfall Pulse
replies.body: [url=synth://kestrel-journal.net/]kestrel-journal.net[/url] has the full text of the letter up already, he typed it out. Credit where it's due.

feed.author: Howard Prewitt
feed.body: "Last service" is the wrong phrase for a diner. Service is what a restaurant does in an evening. The word you want is "last day of trading" or simply "last day."

replies.author: Marguerite H.
replies.body: Howard.

replies.author: Howard Prewitt
replies.body: I am aware of the timing. I have been sat here twenty minutes deciding whether to post it and I posted it, which tells you something about me.

feed.author: Gridfall Pulse
feed.body: Power's out. East side, Quarry Rd and below. Went about 5:41. Co-op line is engaged.

replies.author: Curtis Flenn
replies.body: Out here too. 5:41 matches. Posting from the laptop battery.

feed.author: Curtis Flenn
feed.body: 5:41 out. No bang, no flicker, just gone. Street is completely dark, you can see the stars over the hardware store which I have never once seen.

replies.author: Hettie L.
replies.body: We're fine on 9th. Lights are on. Feels rude.

feed.author: Curtis Flenn
feed.body:
Truck just went past toward the substation. Two of them. Not hurrying, which I take as good news.

Found the candles. They were in the drawer with the batteries, which is where I said they were and where my wife said they were not.

replies.author: Nedra O.
replies.body: Do not gloat about the drawer, Curtis. It's a long evening.

feed.author: Curtis Flenn
feed.body: Ate cold beans standing at the counter in the dark like a man in a film about a man who has given up. 94 minutes.

replies.author: gnash
replies.body: you have a gas stove curtis

replies.author: Curtis Flenn
replies.body: I am aware of that now.

feed.author: Curtis Flenn
feed.body:
Back on. 8:36. Three hours less five minutes.

Every clock in this house is flashing and one of them I do not know how to set. It has been flashing since the substation fire in 03 and I had honestly stopped seeing it.

replies.author: Gridfall Pulse
replies.body: Confirmed back on across the east side. Co-op says a feeder fault, no further detail. Thanks Curtis, you were faster than the co-op by about two hours.

replies.author: Marguerite H.
replies.body: "Feeder fault" is doing a lot of work there. Background on the 03 fire if anyone's new: [url=synth://wiki.gridfall.net/wiki/gridfall-substation-fire]wiki.gridfall.net[/url]

feed.author: Tunde O.
feed.body: Commission meeting last night ran to 11:20 and got through four of eleven items. Forty minutes of it was the sign ordinance. Forty minutes. On signs.

replies.author: Ray Dunleavy
replies.body: It is forty minutes on signs because the item after it was the utilities budget and one of them wanted it pushed to March. Watch who moved to extend debate. It is always the same two.

replies.author: PRINCE_OF_ELM_ST
replies.body: ray sees a conspiracy in a parking ticket. some people just like talking about signs

replies.author: Ray Dunleavy
replies.body: The budget item has been pushed at four consecutive meetings. That is not a conspiracy, it is a calendar, and anyone can go and look at it.

feed.author: Gridfall Pulse
feed.body: School's on a 2 hour delay. Roads are fine in town, it's the county routes. Marchfield buses aren't running at all.

replies.author: Junie Pell
replies.body: can confirm, im at the school, we have four staff and no children

feed.author: Hettie L.
feed.body: Somebody has put a bench at the top of the quarry path. Just a bench. Nobody knows who. It is a good bench, it's bolted down properly and it's in the right spot.

replies.author: gnash
replies.body: no comment

replies.author: Hettie L.
replies.body: gnash.

replies.author: gnash
replies.body: i said no comment

feed.author: dmc
feed.body: put up a clip of the branch trackbed walk from cutlers lane, about 6 min, nothing happens in it, its just walking [url=synth://clipvault.tv/watch/trackbed-walk-feb08]clipvault.tv[/url]

replies.author: Marguerite H.
replies.body: Watched all six minutes. The bit where you go under the bridge and the sound changes is worth it.

feed.author: Nedra O.
feed.body:
At the Kestrel. There is a line out the door and around past the barber's. Delia is at the register and she is not letting anyone else do it.

They ran out of pie at half eleven.

replies.author: Junie Pell
replies.body: im in the line. been in it 40 min. nobody is complaining which for this town is remarkable

replies.author: Howard Prewitt
replies.body: I was there at seven this morning before it filled up. She said "you're early" and I said "I am" and that was the whole conversation and it was the right one.

replies.author: Tunde O.
replies.body: Forty years. Somebody should put it in the wiki properly, the entry's two sentences: [url=synth://wiki.gridfall.net/wiki/blue-kestrel-diner]blue kestrel diner[/url]

feed.author: Gridfall Pulse
feed.body:
Sign's down at the Kestrel. Came off this morning, two fellas and a ladder.

We're told it's going to the historical society and not the dumpster, which is the first bit of sense anybody's shown about that building in a decade.

We're also now on the county webring, if you're the sort of person who uses those: [url=synth://webring.gridfall.net/]webring.gridfall.net[/url]

replies.author: PRINCE_OF_ELM_ST
replies.body: the historical society is three people and a filing cabinet in the library basement. that sign is going in a basement

replies.author: Marguerite H.
replies.body: A basement is still better than the dumpster. I'm one of the three people and I'll take that.

replies.author: PRINCE_OF_ELM_ST
replies.body: i didnt know you were one of the three people
